'''Blizzard 4''' was an [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|All Terrain Armored Transport]] that was part of [[Blizzard Force/Legends|Blizzard Force]]. It was present at the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], commanded by [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Starck/Legends|Starck]]. [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] destroyed Blizzard 4 during the battle with a [[V-59 concussion grenade/Legends|concussion grenade]].

==History==
[[File:Blizzard4GoBoom-TESB.png|thumb|left|200px|The destruction of Blizzard 4]]
Staffed by an experienced crew, Blizzard 4's role in all engagements was to seek out new terrain uncovered by the initial offensive thrust and unload troops to hold it. In an attempt to impress [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], Starck's group went through the treacherous [[Kerane Valley/Legends|Kerane Valley]].<ref name="IWST">''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars Trilogy]]''</ref> Later in the battle, [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], his [[Snowspeeder/Legends|snowspeeder]] crippled and crashed, narrowly dodged the AT-AT's crushing foot, before grappling to its underbelly with a [[Power harpoon launcher|harpoon gun]], cutting through the armor with his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], and using a [[V-59 concussion grenade/Legends|concussion grenade]] to destroy it, the resulting explosions also decapitating it in the process.<ref name="SWEIV" />
